<style>
:root{
  --sheet:#F4F3F5; --white:#FFF; --ink:#131117; --ink-soft:#66646E; --dark:#17151D; --dark-2:#221F2A;
  --mag:#EA215E; --mag-lt:#FF5C86; --mag-tint:#FCE7EF; --line:#E8E6EB;
  --g1:#E70147; --g2:#FFAA4A; --bgimg:url("https://TU-SITIO.com/wp-content/uploads/interkont/IMG%20FONDO-eba0b50c.png");
  --herobg:url("https://TU-SITIO.com/wp-content/uploads/interkont/fondo%202.png");
  --sans:'Mulish',sans-serif;
  --r-xl:34px; --r-lg:26px; --r:18px;
  --sh:0 2px 8px rgba(19,17,23,.04), 0 20px 44px -22px rgba(19,17,23,.16);
  --sh-lg:0 8px 20px rgba(19,17,23,.06), 0 40px 80px -30px rgba(19,17,23,.28);
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:var(--sans); color:var(--ink); line-height:1.6; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  background:radial-gradient(80% 46% at 50% 30%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--mag) 8%, transparent), transparent 62%), #EFEEF2}
a{color:inherit; text-decoration:none} a:hover{color:var(--mag)}
.wrap{max-width:1360px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 clamp(16px,3vw,40px)}
.eyebrow{font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:var(--mag); letter-spacing:.01em}
.btn{font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:700; font-size:15px; border:none; cursor:pointer; border-radius:100px; padding:14px 26px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; transition:transform .2s, box-shadow .3s, background .25s}
.btn .ico{width:17px;height:17px; transition:transform .25s}
.btn-dark{background:var(--ink); color:#fff}
.btn-dark:hover{transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 14px 30px -10px rgba(19,17,23,.5)} .btn-dark:hover .ico{transform:translateX(3px)}
.btn-mag{background:var(--mag); color:#fff}
.btn-mag:hover{transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 16px 34px -10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--mag) 60%, transparent)} .btn-mag:hover .ico{transform:translateX(3px)}
.btn-light{background:#fff; color:var(--ink); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line)}
.btn-light:hover{transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line), var(--sh)}
.btn-glass{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14); color:#fff; -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px); backdrop-filter:blur(10px); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.btn-glass:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.24); transform:translateY(-2px); color:#fff}
.ico{width:1em; height:1em; display:inline-block; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; vertical-align:middle}

header{position:fixed; top:0; left:0; right:0; z-index:80; transition:.35s}
.hbar{max-width:1360px; margin:0 auto; padding:20px clamp(16px,3vw,40px); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; transition:.35s}
header.scrolled{background:rgba(244,243,245,.8); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px); backdrop-filter:blur(16px); box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--line)}
header.scrolled .hbar{padding-top:14px; padding-bottom:14px}
.logo svg{height:27px; display:block}
.logo .logo-c{display:none}
header.scrolled .logo .logo-w{display:none}
header.scrolled .logo .logo-c{display:block}
nav{display:flex; gap:30px; align-items:center}
nav a{font-size:15px; font-weight:600; color:rgba(255,255,255,.82); transition:.2s} nav a:hover{color:#fff}
header.scrolled nav a{color:var(--ink-soft)} header.scrolled nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.menu-tog{display:none; background:none; border:none; font-size:26px; cursor:pointer; color:#fff}
header.scrolled .menu-tog{color:var(--ink)}
.nav-drop{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center}
.nav-dropbtn{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:0;transition:.2s}
.nav-dropbtn .ico{width:15px;height:15px;transition:transform .25s}
header.scrolled .nav-dropbtn{color:var(--ink-soft)}
.nav-drop:hover .nav-dropbtn,header.scrolled .nav-drop:hover .nav-dropbtn{color:var(--mag)}
.nav-drop:hover .nav-dropbtn .ico{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.drop{position:absolute;top:100%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(14px);width:330px;background:#fff;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:var(--sh-lg);padding:10px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:.26s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1);z-index:60}
.drop::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-18px;left:0;right:0;height:18px}
.nav-drop:hover .drop{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(6px)}
.drop a{display:flex;gap:13px;align-items:flex-start;padding:13px;border-radius:14px;color:var(--ink)!important;transition:background .2s}
.drop a:hover{background:var(--sheet);color:var(--ink)!important}
.drop .di{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:11px;flex:none;background:var(--mag-tint);color:var(--mag);display:grid;place-items:center}
.drop .di .ico{width:20px;height:20px}
.drop .dt{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.2;display:block}
.drop .dd{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:3px;line-height:1.4;display:block}

.hero{position:relative; min-height:100vh; margin:0; border-radius:0; overflow:hidden; display:flex; align-items:center; background:#0c0a10; padding:130px 0 70px}
.hero-bg{position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:0; background:radial-gradient(120% 120% at 15% 20%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--mag) 30%, transparent), transparent 55%), repeating-linear-gradient(115deg,#17131d 0 22px,#120f18 22px 44px)}
.hero-grid{position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:1; background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.04) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.04) 1px,transparent 1px); background-size:46px 46px; -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(70% 70% at 55% 40%,#000,transparent); mask-image:radial-gradient(70% 70% at 55% 40%,#000,transparent)}
.hero-inner{position:relative; z-index:2; width:100%; max-width:1360px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 clamp(24px,4vw,64px)}
.hero-content{max-width:840px}
.hero .eyebrow{color:var(--mag-lt); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px}
.hero .eyebrow::before{content:""; width:26px; height:1px; background:var(--mag-lt)}
.hero h1{color:#fff; font-size:clamp(40px,6vw,80px); font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-.04em; line-height:1.0; margin:18px 0 22px}
.hero .sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8); font-size:clamp(16px,1.5vw,20px); max-width:58ch; margin-bottom:30px}
.hero-cta{display:flex; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero-stats{display:flex; gap:34px; margin-top:44px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero-stats .hn{font-size:34px; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:-.03em; color:#fff} .hero-stats .hn .u{color:var(--mag-lt)}
.hero-stats .hl{font-size:12.5px; color:rgba(255,255,255,.55); font-weight:600}

.sec{padding:clamp(56px,7vw,100px) 0}
.h2{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,60px); font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-.035em; line-height:1.0}
.sec-head{max-width:640px; margin-bottom:clamp(34px,4vw,52px)}
.sec-head p{color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:17px; margin-top:12px}

.prodx{display:grid; grid-template-columns:310px 1fr; gap:clamp(20px,3vw,44px); align-items:start}
.tabrail{position:sticky; top:100px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px}
.tabrail button{font-family:var(--sans); text-align:left; font-size:15px; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink-soft); background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; padding:14px 16px; border-radius:14px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:13px; transition:.22s; width:100%}
.tabrail button .ti{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink-soft);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;box-shadow:var(--sh);transition:.22s}
.tabrail button .ti .ico{width:18px;height:18px}
.tabrail button:hover{color:var(--ink); background:#fff; box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.tabrail button.on{color:#fff; background:var(--ink); box-shadow:var(--sh-lg)}
.tabrail button.on .ti{background:var(--mag); color:#fff; box-shadow:none}

.panel{display:none}
.panel.on{display:block; animation:fade .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1)}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(16px)} to{opacity:1; transform:none}}
.pcard-wrap{background:#fff; border-radius:var(--r-xl); padding:clamp(28px,4vw,52px); box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.p-head{display:flex; gap:20px; align-items:flex-start; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:24px}
.p-badge{width:62px;height:62px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--mag-tint);color:var(--mag);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.p-badge .ico{width:28px;height:28px}
.p-head h3{font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,40px); font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-.03em; line-height:1.05}
.p-lead{font-size:clamp(16px,1.5vw,19px); color:var(--ink-soft); line-height:1.6; max-width:66ch; margin-bottom:32px}
.feat{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(215px,1fr)); gap:14px}
.fcard{background:var(--sheet); border-radius:var(--r-lg); padding:24px; transition:.3s}
.fcard:hover{transform:translateY(-5px); box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.fcard .fi{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;color:var(--mag);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:16px;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.fcard .fi .ico{width:22px;height:22px}
.fcard h4{font-size:17px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-.01em} .fcard p{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:6px}
.tier{position:relative}
.tier.hot{background:var(--dark); color:#fff}
.tier.hot .tier-num{color:var(--mag-lt)} .tier.hot h4{color:#fff}
.tier-num{font-size:12px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--mag); margin-bottom:8px}
.chk{list-style:none; margin-top:14px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:9px}
.chk li{display:flex; gap:9px; font-size:13.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); align-items:flex-start}
.tier.hot .chk li{color:rgba(255,255,255,.72)}
.chk .ico{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--mag);flex:none;margin-top:2px} .tier.hot .chk .ico{color:var(--mag-lt)}
.p-foot{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:30px; padding-top:26px; border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.p-foot .note{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--ink-soft)}
.p-sub{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mag);margin:36px 0 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.p-sub::before{content:"";width:22px;height:2px;background:var(--mag);border-radius:2px}
.models{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}
.model{background:var(--sheet);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:26px}
.model.dk{background:var(--dark);color:#fff}
.model .mtag{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mag)}
.model.dk .mtag{color:var(--mag-lt)}
.model h5{font-size:21px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:6px 0 10px}
.model>p{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.55} .model.dk>p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.66)}
.plans{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(178px,1fr));gap:12px}
.plan{background:var(--sheet);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:22px}
.plan.hot{background:var(--dark);color:#fff}
.plan .pnum{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mag)} .plan.hot .pnum{color:var(--mag-lt)}
.plan h5{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;margin:6px 0 4px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.plan .hrs{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink)} .plan.hot .hrs{color:#fff}
.plan p{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:10px;line-height:1.5} .plan.hot p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.66)}
.plan .rn{font-size:32px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--mag);display:block;margin:10px 0 0} .plan.hot .rn{color:var(--mag-lt)}
.plan .rl{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em} .plan.hot .rl{color:rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
.metrics{display:flex;gap:30px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:22px 0 4px}
.metric .mn{font-size:30px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--ink)} .metric .mn .u{color:var(--mag)}
.metric .ml{font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:600;max-width:16ch}
.callout{background:var(--mag-tint);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:20px 22px;display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:26px}
.callout .ico{width:22px;height:22px;color:var(--mag);flex:none;margin-top:1px}
.callout p{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.55}
.speclist{list-style:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px 26px}
.speclist li{display:flex;gap:9px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);align-items:flex-start}
.speclist .ico{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--mag);flex:none;margin-top:2px}
.speclist b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:700}

.final{text-align:center; padding:clamp(80px,10vw,130px) 0}
.final .h2{max-width:18ch; margin:14px auto 18px}
.final p{color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:18px; max-width:48ch; margin:0 auto 30px}
.final-cta{display:flex; gap:12px; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap}

footer{background:var(--ink); color:#fff; padding:64px clamp(16px,3vw,40px) 34px; border-radius:0; margin:14px 0 0; max-width:none; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center}
.fgrid,.fbot{width:100%; max-width:1360px}
.fgrid{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:40px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:38px}
.fbrand{max-width:280px} .fbrand svg{height:27px; margin-bottom:15px} .fbrand p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5); font-size:14px}
.fcol h5{font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:rgba(255,255,255,.4); margin-bottom:15px}
.fcol a{display:block; color:rgba(255,255,255,.7); font-size:14.5px; margin-bottom:10px; transition:.2s} .fcol a:hover{color:#fff}
.fbot{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding-top:24px; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); color:rgba(255,255,255,.4); font-size:13px; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px}

.rv{opacity:1; transform:none}
@supports (animation-timeline: view()){
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){
    @keyframes rv-in{from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(28px)} to{opacity:1; transform:none}}
    .rv{animation:rv-in .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) forwards; animation-timeline:view(); animation-range:entry 0% entry 55%}
  }
}

@media (max-width:960px){
  nav{position:fixed; inset:0 0 0 auto; width:min(80vw,300px); flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; background:#fff; transform:translateX(100%); transition:.4s; padding:40px; gap:24px; z-index:90}
  nav.open{transform:none} nav a{color:var(--ink-soft)} .menu-tog{display:block; z-index:95}
  .nav-drop{width:100%;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
  .nav-dropbtn{color:var(--ink-soft);justify-content:space-between;width:100%}
  .drop{position:static;transform:none!important;opacity:1;visibility:visible;width:auto;box-shadow:none;background:var(--sheet);margin-top:10px;padding:6px}
  .drop::before{display:none}
  .hero-content{max-width:none}
  .prodx{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .tabrail{position:static; flex-direction:row; overflow-x:auto; gap:8px; padding-bottom:8px}
  .tabrail button{white-space:nowrap; width:auto} .tabrail button .ti{display:none}
  .models{grid-template-columns:1fr} .speclist{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none;transition:none}.rv{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* === Gradiente de marca === */
:root{ --grad:linear-gradient(92deg,var(--g1) 0%,var(--g2) 100%); --grad-r:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--g1) 0%,var(--g2) 100%); }
.btn-mag{background:var(--grad)!important}
.btn-mag:hover{box-shadow:0 16px 34px -10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--g1) 55%, transparent)!important}
.eyebrow{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.hero .eyebrow{background:none;-webkit-text-fill-color:initial;color:var(--g2)}
.hero .eyebrow::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--g1),var(--g2))}

.fcard .fi,.p-badge,.drop .di{background:var(--grad)!important;color:#fff!important}
.tabrail button.on .ti{background:var(--grad)!important;color:#fff!important}
.p-sub::before{background:var(--grad)!important}
.callout{background:linear-gradient(92deg,color-mix(in srgb, var(--g1) 10%, transparent),color-mix(in srgb, var(--g2) 14%, transparent))!important}
.callout .ico{color:var(--g1)}
.plan .rn,.metric .mn .u{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.plan.hot .rn{color:var(--g2);-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--g2)}
.hero-stats .hn .u{color:var(--g2)}
footer{border-radius:0!important; margin:0!important; max-width:none!important; width:100%!important; padding:clamp(72px,9vw,120px) clamp(28px,4vw,56px) 44px!important; min-height:clamp(420px,44vw,560px)!important; display:flex!important; flex-direction:column!important; justify-content:space-between!important; background:#0b0910!important; background-image:var(--bgimg)!important; background-size:cover!important; background-position:center!important; background-attachment:fixed!important; position:relative}
footer::before{content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:inherit; background:none; pointer-events:none}
.fgrid,.fbot{position:relative; z-index:2}
.hero-bg{background:#0b0910 var(--herobg) center/cover no-repeat!important}
.btn-dark:hover{box-shadow:0 14px 30px -10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--g1) 45%, transparent)!important}

.model.dk,.plan.hot,.fcard.tier.hot{background:#0b0910!important; background-image:var(--bgimg)!important; background-size:cover!important; background-position:center!important; background-attachment:fixed!important; position:relative; overflow:hidden}
.model.dk::before,.plan.hot::before,.fcard.tier.hot::before{content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:inherit; background:none; pointer-events:none; z-index:0}
.model.dk>*,.plan.hot>*,.fcard.tier.hot>*{position:relative; z-index:1}
.tabrail button.on{background:#0b0910!important; background-image:var(--bgimg)!important; background-size:cover!important; background-position:center!important; background-attachment:fixed!important; position:relative; overflow:hidden}
.tabrail button.on::before{content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:inherit; background:none; pointer-events:none; z-index:0}
.tabrail button.on>*,.tabrail button.on{color:#fff}
.tabrail button.on .ti{position:relative; z-index:1}

/* Parallax fiable: sin transform en los contenedores con imagen */
footer,.model.dk,.plan.hot,.fcard.tier.hot,.tabrail button.on{transform:none!important; animation-name:rv-fade!important; backdrop-filter:none!important; -webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important}
footer,.model.dk,.plan.hot,.fcard.tier.hot,.tabrail button.on{background-attachment:fixed!important; background-size:cover!important; background-position:center center!important; background-repeat:no-repeat!important}
@keyframes rv-fade{from{opacity:0} to{opacity:1}}
footer:hover,.model.dk:hover,.plan.hot:hover,.fcard.tier.hot:hover,.tabrail button.on:hover{transform:none!important}
footer *,.model.dk *,.plan.hot *,.fcard.tier.hot *,.tabrail button.on *{position:relative; z-index:2}

/* Cursor personalizado con estela difuminada */
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
  html,body{cursor:none}
  a,button,.tab,.tabrail button,.bfilters button,input,textarea,select,[role="button"]{cursor:none}
  #ikcur,#ikblur{position:fixed; top:0; left:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:9999; will-change:transform; opacity:0}
  body.ikready #ikcur{opacity:1}
  body.ikready #ikblur{opacity:.85}
  #ikcur{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad);margin:-4.5px 0 0 -4.5px;transition:width .22s,height .22s,margin .22s,opacity .3s}
  #ikblur{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;margin:-26px 0 0 -26px;background:radial-gradient(circle,color-mix(in srgb, var(--g1) 50%, transparent),color-mix(in srgb, var(--g2) 34%, transparent) 55%,transparent 72%);filter:blur(11px);transition:width .3s,height .3s,margin .3s,opacity .3s}
  body.ikhot #ikcur{width:0;height:0;margin:0}
  body.ikhot #ikblur{width:82px;height:82px;margin:-41px 0 0 -41px;opacity:1}
  body.ikready.ikmove #ikblur{opacity:1}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ html,body,a,button{cursor:auto!important} #ikcur,#ikblur{display:none!important} }

/* === Navbar flotante === */
header{background:none!important; box-shadow:none!important}
header .hbar{position:relative; margin:14px auto 0; padding:10px 14px 10px 24px; border-radius:100px; background:none;
  max-width:calc(1360px - 2*clamp(16px,2.6vw,34px)); width:calc(100% - 2*clamp(16px,2.6vw,34px)); transition:.35s}

/* ============ Aparición al hacer scroll ============ */
@supports (animation-timeline: view()){
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){

  @keyframes ap-up{from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(38px)} to{opacity:1; transform:none}}
  @keyframes ap-in{from{opacity:0} to{opacity:1}}
  @keyframes ap-left{from{opacity:0; transform:translateX(-34px)} to{opacity:1; transform:none}}
  @keyframes ap-right{from{opacity:0; transform:translateX(34px)} to{opacity:1; transform:none}}
  @keyframes ap-scale{from{opacity:0; transform:scale(.94)} to{opacity:1; transform:none}}

  /* --- Titulares y bloques de encabezado --- */
  .sec-head,.func-head,.dash-head,.mv-head,.iad-head,.split>div,.sb-head{
    animation:ap-up .85s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) forwards;
    animation-timeline:view(); animation-range:entry 0% entry 92%}

  /* --- Tarjetas y bloques de contenido --- */
  .card,.prod,.func,.fcard,.agent,.bcard,.step,.invc,.svcx,.iad-item,.mv-card,
  .model,.plan,.kpibox,.sc,.pcard-wrap,.abody,.acard,.acta,.partners,.stat-band,
  .eye,.ux,.bfeat,.news,.chat,.orbit,.tool>div,.prods>div,.cards>div{
    animation:ap-up .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) forwards;
    animation-timeline:view(); animation-range:entry 0% entry 88%}

  /* --- Escalonado por columna en grillas --- */
  .funcs>*:nth-child(3n+2),.agents>*:nth-child(4n+2),.cards>*:nth-child(3n+2),
  .feat>*:nth-child(2n),.steps>*:nth-child(3n+2),.iad-grid>*:nth-child(3n+2),
  .bgrid>*:nth-child(3n+2),.svc>*:nth-child(3n+2){animation-range:entry 0% entry 100%}
  .funcs>*:nth-child(3n),.agents>*:nth-child(4n),.cards>*:nth-child(3n),
  .steps>*:nth-child(3n),.iad-grid>*:nth-child(3n),.bgrid>*:nth-child(3n),
  .svc>*:nth-child(3n){animation-range:entry 0% entry 112%}
  .agents>*:nth-child(4n+3){animation-range:entry 0% entry 106%}

  /* --- Entradas laterales en bloques a dos columnas --- */
  .eye>div:first-child,.ux-txt{animation-name:ap-left}
  .eye>.scan,.ux-vis{animation-name:ap-right}
  .ceo-card{animation-name:ap-left} .ceo-quote{animation-name:ap-right}

  /* --- Elementos que no pueden transformarse (parallax) --- */
  .stat-band,.eye,.ux,.bfeat,.news,.iad,.mv-band,.agent.count,.invc.dk,
  .model.dk,.plan.hot,.fcard.tier.hot,.card.dk,.prod.dk,.ceo-card,.pull,.acta,footer{
    animation-name:ap-in !important}

  /* --- Listas y detalles --- */
  .chk li,.eye-caps li,.speclist li,.mv-vals li,.srcs span,.pchip,.alerts .alert{
    animation:ap-up .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) forwards;
    animation-timeline:view(); animation-range:entry 0% entry 96%}
  .chk li:nth-child(even),.eye-caps li:nth-child(even),.speclist li:nth-child(even){
    animation-range:entry 0% entry 110%}

  /* --- Burbujas de chat, escalonadas --- */
  .msg{animation:ap-scale .7s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) forwards; animation-timeline:view(); animation-range:entry 0% entry 94%}
  .msg:nth-child(2){animation-range:entry 0% entry 104%}
  .msg:nth-child(3){animation-range:entry 0% entry 114%}
  .msg:nth-child(4){animation-range:entry 0% entry 124%}

  /* --- CTA de cierre y footer --- */
  .final>div,.iad-cta,.final-cta{animation:ap-up .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) forwards; animation-timeline:view(); animation-range:entry 0% entry 90%}
  .fgrid>div{animation:ap-up .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) forwards; animation-timeline:view(); animation-range:entry 0% cover 30%}
  .fgrid>div:nth-child(2){animation-range:entry 0% cover 38%}
  .fgrid>div:nth-child(3){animation-range:entry 0% cover 46%}
  .fgrid>div:nth-child(4){animation-range:entry 0% cover 54%}

  /* --- El hero no se anima (ya es visible al cargar) --- */
  .hero,.hero *{animation-name:none !important}
}}

<script>
(function(){
  if (window.__ikBooted) return; window.__ikBooted = true;
  class DCLogic {
    constructor(){ this.props = {}; this.state = {}; }
    setState(o){ Object.assign(this.state, typeof o === 'function' ? o(this.state) : o); }
    forceUpdate(){}
  }
  class Component extends DCLogic {
    componentDidMount() { this.init(); }
    componentDidUpdate() { this.applyTheme(); }
    applyTheme() {
      const t = localStorage.getItem('ik-theme') === 'purple';
      document.body.classList.toggle('tp', t);
      const b = document.getElementById('thm');
      if (b) b.setAttribute('data-theme', t ? 'purple' : 'original');
      document.documentElement.classList.add('notrans');
      void document.body.offsetWidth;
      setTimeout(() => document.documentElement.classList.remove('notrans'), 60);
    }
    init() {
  
      (() => {
        if (!matchMedia('(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)').matches) return;
        const SEL = '.card,.prod,.func,.fcard,.agent,.bcard,.step,.invc,.svcx,.iad-item,.mv-card,.model,.plan,.kpibox,.sc,.aw,.tr,.tst,.cs,.mt-card,.acard,.chat';
        let last = null;
        addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
          const el = e.target instanceof Element ? e.target.closest(SEL) : null;
          if (el !== last && last) { last.style.removeProperty('--mx'); last.style.removeProperty('--my'); }
          last = el;
          if (!el) return;
          const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
          el.style.setProperty('--mx', ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width * 100).toFixed(1) + '%');
          el.style.setProperty('--my', ((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height * 100).toFixed(1) + '%');
        }, { passive: true });
      })();
  
      document.querySelectorAll('.hero-vid').forEach(v => {
        v.muted = true; v.defaultMuted = true; v.loop = true; v.playsInline = true;
        v.setAttribute('muted',''); v.setAttribute('loop','');
        const show = () => v.classList.add('ready');
        const p = () => { const r = v.play(); if (r && r.catch) r.catch(() => {}); };
        v.addEventListener('loadeddata', () => { show(); p(); }, { once: true });
        v.addEventListener('canplay', p, { once: true });
        v.addEventListener('playing', show, { once: true });
        document.addEventListener('click', p, { once: true });
        if (v.readyState >= 2) { show(); p(); } else { p(); }
      });
      this.applyTheme();
      const thm = document.getElementById('thm');
      if (thm) thm.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const next = localStorage.getItem('ik-theme') === 'purple' ? 'original' : 'purple';
        localStorage.setItem('ik-theme', next);
        this.applyTheme();
      });
  
      if (matchMedia('(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)').matches && !matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches && !document.getElementById('ikcur')) {
        const dot = document.createElement('div'); dot.id = 'ikcur';
        const blur = document.createElement('div'); blur.id = 'ikring';
        document.body.append(blur, dot);
        addEventListener('mousedown', () => document.body.classList.add('ikdown'));
        addEventListener('mouseup', () => document.body.classList.remove('ikdown'));
        let mx = innerWidth / 2, my = innerHeight / 2, bx = mx, by = my, idle;
        addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
          if (!document.body.classList.contains('ikready')) { bx = mx = e.clientX; by = my = e.clientY; document.body.classList.add('ikready'); dot.style.opacity = '1'; blur.style.opacity = '1'; }
          mx = e.clientX; my = e.clientY;
          dot.style.transform = 'translate(' + mx + 'px,' + my + 'px)';
          document.body.classList.add('ikmove');
          clearTimeout(idle); idle = setTimeout(() => document.body.classList.remove('ikmove'), 220);
          const el = e.target instanceof Element ? e.target : null;
          const t = el && el.closest('a,button,.tab,input,textarea,select,[role="button"],.card,.prod,.func,.fcard,.agent,.bcard,.mv-card,.iad-item,.step,.invc,.svcx,.sc,.plan,.model,.kpibox,svg,.chat,.mock,.scan,.panel,.pz');
          document.body.classList.toggle('ikhot', !!t);
        }, { passive: true });
        const loop = () => { bx += (mx - bx) * 0.16; by += (my - by) * 0.16; blur.style.transform = 'translate(' + bx + 'px,' + by + 'px)'; requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
        loop();
      }
      const header = document.getElementById('header');
      const hero = document.querySelector('.hero');
      if (header && hero) {
        const onScroll = () => header.classList.toggle('scrolled', hero.getBoundingClientRect().bottom < 70);
        window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
        onScroll();
      }
      const tog = document.getElementById('tog'), nav = document.getElementById('nav');
      if (tog && nav) {
        const setNav = (open) => document.body.classList.toggle('navopen', open);
        tog.addEventListener('click', () => setNav(!document.body.classList.contains('navopen')));
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          const el = e.target instanceof Element ? e.target : null;
          if (el && el.closest('#nav a')) setNav(false);
        });
        addEventListener('resize', () => setNav(false));
        setNav(false);
      }
  
  
      const rail = document.getElementById('tabrail'), panels = document.getElementById('panels');
      if (rail && panels) {
        const btns = [...rail.querySelectorAll('button')], pans = [...panels.querySelectorAll('.panel')];
        rail.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          const b = e.target.closest('button'); if (!b) return;
          const i = +b.dataset.p;
          btns.forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('on', x === b));
          pans.forEach(p => p.classList.toggle('on', +p.dataset.p === i));
        });
      }
    }
  }
  var boot = function(){
    try { var c = new Component(); if (c.componentDidMount) c.componentDidMount(); }
    catch (e) { console.warn('Interkont init:', e); }
  };
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>
